title: Wall Mount Towel Bar 30-Inch Solid Brass Straight Bar | Que New Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bathroom with a 30-Inch wall mount towel bar that keeps towels organized while saving space with a clean, straight-bar profile.

  • Coordinated look: Part of the Que New collection for matching versatile bath accessories
  • Solid brass construction: Built from brass for enduring everyday use
  • Clean installation: Concealed screw mounting hardware
  • Finish flexibility: Available in a wide variety of designer finishes, including statement colors
  • What’s included: Towel bar, mounting plates, and all installation hardware

Specifications

  • Center-to-center: 30 inches
  • Overall dimensions: 33 inches W x 3 inches H
  • Projection: 3 inches
  • Bar diameter: 0.5 inches
  • Mounting type: Wall mount
  • Weight capacity: 10 lb
  • Assembly required: No
  • Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4 in
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

_previous.title: Que New Collection 30 Inch Towel Bar
_previous.description: This stylish traditional towel bar will be a nice addition to your bathroom décor. Towel Bar is made of solid brass to insure the product will not rust and the designer finishes will provide a lifetime of beauty.
